mapper.select: select user_id as friend_id , user_name as friend_name from user where user_id in (select friend_id from friend where user_id = #{userId})
select count(*) from friend where user_id = #{userId} and friend_id = #{friendId}
mapper.delete: delete from friend where (user_id = #{userId} and friend_id = #{friendId}) or (user_id = #{friendId} and friend_id = #{userId})
